plan.fit_summary: Strong fit: DACHSER is a Germany-based global logistics provider with approximately 427 company-owned branches across 43 countries [5] and operates a dedicated DACHSER Food Logistics business for temperature-sensitive goods [3].

who.why: Owns the food logistics business that promises customers quality and reliability from pickup to delivery for sensitive goods such as wine & spirits [3].
Would own the temperature documentation behind the pickup-to-delivery quality promise DACHSER makes in food logistics [3].

plan.hook: DACHSER Food Logistics publicly promises quality and reliability 'from pickup to delivery' for temperature-sensitive goods like wine & spirits [3]. ColdTrace's wireless sensors and automatic audit reports make that promise continuously verifiable without manual paperwork.
plan.channel: Phone call first (or a LinkedIn message) to the Food Logistics / quality organization, with a concrete reason: how automatic temperature audit reports support their stated pickup-to-delivery quality promise [3]. DACHSER is Germany-based [5], so under UWG § 7 cold email requires prior consent — use the email draft only after consent or send it as a letter. Not legal advice.
avoid: Do not claim audit or compliance pressure — the sources contain no evidence of it.
Do not imply their current temperature monitoring is manual or inadequate — no source describes their existing setup.
Do not name individuals or cite figures beyond the sourced ones (approximately 427 branches across 43 countries [5]).
questions: How do you currently capture temperature data across your food logistics network and turn it into audit-ready documentation?

draft.body:
DACHSER Food Logistics verspricht öffentlich Qualität und Zuverlässigkeit „von der Abholung bis zur Zustellung“ für temperaturempfindliche Waren wie Wein und Spirituosen [3]. Dieses Versprechen lückenlos zu belegen, bedeutet in der Praxis oft aufwendige Dokumentation entlang der gesamten Kühlkette. Unsere drahtlosen Temperatursensoren erfassen die Daten automatisch und erstellen prüfungsfertige Berichte ohne manuellen Aufwand. Ist das ein Thema, das Sie gerade beschäftigt?
